items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: One night as a matter of fact, we were at Benny Carter’s house for dinner. And I had a tape recorder with me.

ctx.x: They found it. And they didn’t massacre it at all, they found it. He put it in. Whit, whit, whit — “I’ll See You In —” One night as a matter of fact, we were at Benny Carter’s house for dinner. And I had a tape recorder with me. And I had a recording of the band, the all-blind band playing “Night Fall.” And he says, “Who is that?” I said, “Well you know the tune, don’t you?” “Yeah.” So I explained to him about the all-blind band. So I guess you know there was, jazz came into England and we copy.
